items.title: 19.2 Hydrocarbons (sirf carbon aur hydrogen ke compounds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of hydrocarbons and their classes (PDF 39-40).

blocks.title: Hydrocarbons
blocks.text: Hydrocarbons woh compounds hain jin mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen hon.

items: Khuli zanjeer (acyclic) wale hydrocarbons aam taur par aliphatic kehlate hain (Yunani aleiphatos, yani charbi, se, kyunke charbi ki banawat khuli zanjeer wali hai). Yeh saturated (alkanes) ya unsaturated (alkenes aur alkynes) hote hain.

blocks.alt: Chhota peela dabba: 'Aliphatic' likha oval, jama ka nishan aur 'Cyclic' likha oval, lakeeron se neeche 'Alicyclic' likhe mustateel se jure hue.
blocks.caption: Aliphatic + cyclic: alicyclic (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ka yeh chhota khaaka kehta hai: jo hydrocarbon halqa (cyclic) rakhta ho lekin rawaiya aliphatic jaisa ho, woh alicyclic hai. Poori taqseem yun samjhein: hydrocarbons ya to khuli zanjeer (aliphatic: saturated alkanes, unsaturated alkenes aur alkynes) hain ya band zanjeer (cyclic); cyclic mein alicyclic (maslan cyclohexane) aur aromatic (benzene jaise halqe) aate hain.

items: Band zanjeer (cyclic) wale hydrocarbons mein carbon atoms ke halqe hote hain. Alicyclic hydrocarbons, saturated ya unsaturated, aliphatic ki tarah rawaiya rakhte hain, maslan cycloalkanes aur cycloalkenes. Aromatic hydrocarbons mein benzene ring ya us jaisi banawat hoti hai, maslan benzene, naphthalene aur diphenylmethane.

blocks.alt: Do groups jin ke darmiyan moti lakeer hai. Aliphatic hydrocarbons: CH3-CH3 (ethane), H2C=CH2 (ethene), HC teen-bond CH (ethyne) aur aik hexagon (cyclohexane). Aromatic hydrocarbons, har halqa hexagon jis ke andar daira: benzene, methyl benzene (halqe par CH3), naphthalene (do jure halqe) aur anthracene (teen jure halqe aik qatar mein).
blocks.caption: Aliphatic aur aromatic hydrocarbons ki misalein (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab cyclohexane ko 'Aliphatic hydrocarbons' ki taraf rakhti hai, kyunke alicyclic compounds ka rawaiya aliphatic jaisa hota hai. Aromatic taraf har halqe ke andar ka daira benzene ke phaile hue (delocalised) pi electrons dikhata hai. Naphthalene mein do aur anthracene mein teen benzene halqe aapas mein jure (fused) hain.

blocks.prompt: Methylcyclohexane, aik methylcyclohexene, methylbenzene, naphthalene aur cyclohexane ko aliphatic, alicyclic ya aromatic mein taqseem karein.
blocks.explanation: Methylcyclohexane, methylcyclohexene aur cyclohexane alicyclic hain; methylbenzene aur naphthalene aromatic hain.

items: Cyclic: alicyclic (maslan cyclohexane) ya aromatic (benzene rings).
